name: Unlocking all features enables Blitz mode and launches 60s game screen
description: User opens Settings, enables unlockAllFeatures, navigates to Treino Mental, and enters the 60s Blitz mode game screen.

planSteps.description: Click the Configurações button in the top navigation bar
Click the switch toggle for Desbloquear Todos os Recursos
Click the close button to dismiss the settings modal
Click on the Treino Mental tab in the top navigation bar
Click on the Modo Blitz game card
Verify the Blitz ready screen is displayed showing MODO BLITZ and the Iniciar Blitz 60s button
